title: Epic completion rule enforcement
description: An epic cannot transition to status 'done' if any of its children are not done. Enforce this in two places: (1) the graph validator (validate-backlog-graph.js) must report an error if an epic is done but has non-done children, (2) a new function checkEpicCompletion(projectDir, epicId) in a shared module that can be called by other tools. The function reads all backlog items, finds children via parent_id, and returns { ok, incomplete_children }.
stop_condition: An epic with non-done children cannot be marked done. The graph validator reports this as an error. Tests prove the rule with synthetic data.
